verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5080 is a consumer graphics card, not a hosted service with production data, so a sandbox-versus-production test environment does not apply to this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships such a capability. Local private AI execution and CUDA containers are host or developer building blocks, not a product-provided sandbox, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
